title: The Asteroid Collision
logline: A massive asteroid is on a collision course with a criminal base, and a surveyor is hired to redirect it using precise explosive charges.

roles.description: Brilliant at math, terrible under pressure.
Refuses to evacuate, viewing it as a sign of weakness.
A sprawling, illegal mining and smuggling hub.
Independent haulers offering to evacuate people for exorbitant fees.

public_situation: An unusually dense asteroid has unexpectedly shifted orbit and is heading straight for a populated sector.
private_truth: The asteroid was nudged by a rival syndicate trying to wipe out the base without firing a shot.

beats.public_change: The asteroid's trajectory is confirmed publically, sparking a panic.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to fly extremely close to the incoming asteroid and map its structural fault lines.
missions.private_fact: The surveyor's previous calculations were wrong, and they are desperately trying to fix them before anyone notices.

beats.public_change: The evacuation fleet arrives and demands double their usual rates.

missions.reason: Needs highly explosive thorium delivered to construct the seismic charges.
missions.private_fact: The boss is holding the surveyor's family hostage to ensure they don't flee.

beats.public_change: The asteroid enters the final approach window.

missions.reason: Needs the armed seismic charges delivered and planted on the precise fault lines mapped earlier.
missions.private_fact: The surveyor realizes the blast will rain debris onto a nearby civilian settlement instead.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the final armed charges.

options.label: Plant the charges and save the base
Refuse to plant them to spare the civilians
Force the boss to evacuate instead

resolutions.summary: The asteroid shatters. The base is saved, but the civilian settlement is heavily damaged by debris.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot refuses to plant the charges or fails the missions.
resolutions.summary: The asteroid obliterates the base. The civilians are spared, but the crime boss is ruined.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the boss to evacuate.
resolutions.summary: The base is destroyed and the boss escapes with the gang's money, but the surveyor walks free and the lanes around the base reopen.

loose_threads.detail: The asteroid had heavy-duty industrial thrusters covertly bolted to its dark side.
The evacuation fleet set their exorbitant prices weeks before the asteroid's trajectory shifted.

radio_hooks: Massive asteroid on collision course with outer sectors.
Price gouging reported among independent evacuation haulers.

voice_direction.nervous_surveyor: Stammering, calculating out loud, very stressed.
